name: Kaggle
summary: Download Kaggle datasets into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3, using a Kaggle username and API key.

fields.name: api_key
fields.label: API key
fields.help: Created in your Kaggle account settings. Store it with ogun secrets set.

egress.note: Downloads redirect to a storage host that is not fixed. Add the host the first run reports.

operators.summary: Download the files of a Kaggle dataset into the artifact store, hashed with BLAKE3.

notes: Each Kaggle dataset has its own licence; check it before use or redistribution. Ogun never reads a kaggle.json file from your home directory: the key comes from Ogun's secret store.
